dedupe_keys.name: historical canadian provincial marketable natural gas production

description: Historical Canadian Provincial Marketable Natural Gas Production is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Canada Energy Regulator | La Régie de l’énergie du Canada. This data set provides historical monthly marketable natural gas production by province from the beginning of 2000 to the most current available month for each province. Data is gathered from provincial government websites and marketable natural gas is calculated. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Canada Energy Regulator | La Régie de l’énergie du Canada. Its tags are British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Nova Scotia, Ontario. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-06-19 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
